entities.name: ScopeEnvelope
invariants: Every account/document/draft/event/read is scoped and authorized server-side.
Client-supplied owner/environment/synthetic labels cannot grant access or choose a production target.

entities.name: Money
entities.purpose: A signed decimal amount with an explicit ISO currency
fields: quality:known|estimated; unknown is a missing parent field with reason
invariants: No binary float, NaN, infinity or implicit currency.
An unknown amount is a missing parent field with a reason, not numeric zero.
Quote-unit GBX is distinct from currency GBP; conversion must occur exactly once.

entities.name: InstrumentListing
entities.purpose: Security/share-class identity and venue-specific quote contract
invariants: ISIN alone does not uniquely identify a listing or trading currency.
Ticker aliases are effective-dated and venue-scoped.
Real catalogue IDs are used in fixtures; unresolved identity stays unresolved.

entities.name: InvestmentAccount
entities.purpose: An owner-scoped investment account and context
fields: external_reference:protected token or minimized display alias
invariants: No broker trading credentials or execution authority.
Account kinds/markets extend through versioned contracts; tax treatment is not inferred from a label.
Cross-account imports/transfers require explicit authorized mappings.

entities.name: SourceDocument
invariants: Private encrypted originals precede extraction; failed/rejected uploads remain observable.
A storage upload is not an applied financial import.
24-month renewable original archive is confirmed; automatic expiry/deletion mechanics remain unapproved.

entities.name: ExtractionCandidate
invariants: No tools or financial writes in document extraction.
Field confidence is not approval or proof of accuracy.
PDF passwords are handled only through a future secure local unlock flow, never prompts/logs or retained extraction records.

entities.name: ImportDraft
invariants: Any edit, mapping change, subset choice or reprocess changes the review hash.
Rows cannot silently vanish from the preview.
No financial writes before an eligible owner approval and commit.

entities.name: OwnerApproval
invariants: Approval binds the exact payload/scope/version; a chat yes is not an unscoped reusable credential.
Stale, expired, replayed or wrong-environment approvals cannot mutate records.
The sensitive-action freshness duration is still a proposal, not a chosen value.

entities.name: LedgerEvent
entities.purpose: A recorded economic event, never a trade instruction
invariants: Events are append-only; corrections produce linked new events.
Unlike currencies/quantities are never numerically summed as if interchangeable.
Financial event, durable audit and publication/outbox obligations share an atomic logical commit boundary.

entities.name: CommitReceipt
invariants: Exactly one logical application under retries, not exactly-once message delivery.
Readers/agents/outbox consumers exclude staged or failed work.
Large imports must prove atomic visibility and fenced concurrency within the selected store's limits.

entities.name: PositionObservation
entities.purpose: A dated holding/valuation report with explicit sufficiency
invariants: A holdings snapshot is not evidence of a purchase date or external cash flow.
Later history must reconcile/rebase an observation rather than double-count it.
A factsheet describes an instrument and does not prove owner quantity or ownership.

entities.name: ReconciliationResult
invariants: No unexplained plug event or silent source-value replacement.
Cash, quantity, fees, FX, units, action/date and history completeness reconcile separately.
Unresolved material conflicts block dependent metrics/actions, not unrelated valid facts.

entities.name: MetricResult
entities.purpose: A value with eligibility, scope and method
invariants: Zero return and unavailable return are different.
XIRR scope/cash-flow signs/history and terminal valuation must be valid.
Financial forecasts/metrics retain the input revision used when issued.

entities.name: AuditEvidence
invariants: No sampling of required business audit/forecast lineage.
Hash chaining alone is not tamper-proof against an actor able to rewrite all records/anchors.
Owner source deletion and recoverable backups must not resurrect deleted content or misrepresent evidence availability.

entities.name: DomainNotification
invariants: SSE/notifications are advisory; durable authenticated reads establish the truth.
A disconnect never re-applies an import or supplies proof of commit.
Generic logs/push previews exclude private document contents and portfolio values.

api_candidates.purpose: Scoped upload intent; no ledger mutation
Confirm byte/checksum receipt; idempotent and reconciled
Create draft from a validated source or manual input
Create a new revision; never edit an approved hash in place
Bind fresh owner approval to payload and ledger revision
Request recorded-data commit; not trade execution
Resolve ambiguous timeout to the same receipt
Preview a linked reversal, then require its own approval
Read versioned projections with quality/missing-data flags
Paginated dated history, scoped and versioned
Short-lived authorized original access and access audit
Resumable safe SSE progress; durable reads recover state

pending_choices.title: Precision, rounding and reconciliation tolerances
pending_choices.recommendation: Preserve source precision and booked net amounts; deterministic decimal calculations and display rounding. Approve bounds/tolerances per field/asset.

pending_choices.title: Incomplete snapshot rebase when history arrives
pending_choices.recommendation: Versioned owner-confirmed replacement of the baseline/history window; no invented purchase or double counting.

pending_choices.title: Partial-file import policy
pending_choices.recommendation: Resolve blockers or explicitly approve a consistent subset with exclusions visible and a new hash; no silent partial commit.

pending_choices.title: File limits, protected files and extraction budget
pending_choices.recommendation: Bounded, versioned file/page/archive/pixel/runtime limits; the old MA20MB/15-minute values are candidate references, not MP approvals.

pending_choices.title: Cost-basis and realised-gain methods
pending_choices.recommendation: Use source-supported basis; defer unsupported analytical/tax gain measures until method/jurisdiction/wrapper contracts are approved.

pending_choices.title: Trade-date versus settlement-date accounting
pending_choices.recommendation: Explicit economic exposure and settled/unsettled cash state; no hardcoded venue settlement rule without verification.

pending_choices.title: Financial/audit retention and deletion matrix
pending_choices.recommendation: Keep required ledger/forecast/approval joins separate from operational TTLs and renewable raw-original policy; exact durations and deletion consequences need owner approval.

pending_choices.title: Large-import storage/visibility design
pending_choices.recommendation: Fenced staged batches and one validated activation decision; prove no partial visibility, retry safety and bounded read/write costs before selecting the physical design.

pending_choices.title: Draft/approval expiry and idempotency retention
pending_choices.recommendation: Bind approvals to payload/revision with a chosen short lifetime; preserve business idempotency for retained history rather than relying on a provider's short token window.

pending_choices.title: Execution FX and valuation FX conventions
pending_choices.recommendation: Store booked execution cash/rate separately from a permitted reference FX series; choose dated source/fallback before live use.
